text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Haru Urara and I were
about to part ways at the school gate, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... This sucks...
I have to study for the test once I get home...
choice_data_list: Is a test coming up soon?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah... So I thought I'd ask King-chan to teach me, just like always—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, Urara-san. What a coincidence, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! King-chan,
good timing... wait.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! King-chan, you look so gorgeous!
Where are you off to!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? I-It's just shopping!
What's with you all of a sudden... calling me, p-pretty...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Seriously... We share a room, so you must've seen my casual clothes plenty of times by now.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I always thought
your outfits looked so grown-up! So cool~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! Wh-Wh-What...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm so jealous, I wanna try wearing that too!
I feel like it'd make me look like such a cool older girl~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph! Well, if you insist that much,
I suppose I could pick something out for you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! Trainer, come with us too! It's gonna be so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, yaaay!
Let's become super "cooool" together♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second?!
Coordinate outfits for two people?! Why do I have to—"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: King-chan, nice to be working with you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez!! Alright, fine!
I'll make you all shine with the King's sense of style!
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aye-aye, sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a wonderful time with Haru Urara,
receiving guidance from King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, however...
Haru Urara ended up stuck in remedial classes.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Gaaah!!!! That's... right...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that upcoming thing.
...What the heck, now's no time to be shopping.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah, what a relief.
Now I can shop calmly by myself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uuu... King-chan...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, geez!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I told you to always do things properly, exactly because you'd end up having to teach someone like this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: King-chan...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back and finish this up quick!
I've already put together some practice problems for you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...!
King-chaaaan! Thank you sooo much~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The shopping was a bust,
but thanks to that, Haru Urara managed to
avoid failing her test...!
